name: admin_conversations_ekm_list_original_connected_channel_info
description: List all disconnected channels—i.e., channels that were once connected to other workspaces and then disconnected—and the corresponding orig… (GET /admin.conversations.ekm.listOriginalConnectedChannelInfo)
